Body.Content:
The enhanced Project Contract experience streamlines how you create, manage, and monitor contracts by significantly reducing the number of clicks and interactions required. This update transforms the contract into a central, intuitive workspace where all contract-related information is easier to access, understand, and act upon. The redesigned layout provides a clearer overview of contract status, financials, and performance, helping users work faster and with greater confidence.

Core capabilities:

Modernized user experience: Aligns with improvements delivered in the Modern Quote feature and reduces unnecessary interactions across contract workflows.

Nested grids for better visibility: Quickly view detailed estimate breakdowns for each contract line directly within the grid—no need to open multiple forms.

Faster contract line management: Create and edit Contract Line Details from a single grid, including the ability to apply price overrides.

Improved financial clarity: Contract summary now includes key KPIs, total cost, gross margin, billing status, and tax information surfaced directly on the grid.

Streamlined contract lifecycle: Users can close a contract directly from the contract form, supported by improved visibility into contract health.

Contract performance dashboard: Enhanced insights to help users quickly understand contract progress and financial performance.

Business Value:

This enhancement significantly improves the efficiency and clarity of managing project contracts. By reducing clicks, consolidating key information, and modernizing the user experience, you can create, review, and update contracts much faster. Financial insights such as margins, costs, and billing status help users identify issues early and make confident decisions. Overall, the streamlined contract workspace reduces errors, accelerates project initiation, and improves productivity for project and billing teams.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

GA date: September CY2027

Preview date: September CY2026
